categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the design, manufacturing, and sales of computer and server chassis, including metal mechanical stamping parts and molds. It also operates in related sectors such as electrical appliance manufacturing, wired and wireless communication equipment, electronic components, computer equipment installation, telecommunications wholesale and retail, intellectual property, software services, data processing, and product design. The main revenue driver is computer and server chassis, accounting for 97% of sales.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced metal stamping and mold manufacturing technologies for chassis production. It emphasizes automated and intelligent manufacturing processes aligned with Industry 4.0, including smart production lines and automated equipment. Key technological focuses include water cooling and immersion liquid cooling solutions for servers, thermal transmission, heat dissipation testing, and energy-saving chassis designs. The company continuously develops new server chassis designs (1U, 2U Intel Edge MHS, Nvidia MGX AI Server) and cooling technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves major global technology firms in the computer and server industry, focusing on AI server manufacturers and cloud service providers. Its products are essential components for desktop computers, servers, and data centers. Key customers include large-scale data center operators, especially in the US, driven by AI, cloud computing, IoT, 5G, and digital transformation trends.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates production bases in Taiwan, Dongguan and Ningbo in China, and a newly established facility in Thailand. Its sales markets are primarily export-oriented, with major sales in China (36.4%), Taiwan (26.8%), and the United States (33.5%), along with other countries making up a small portion. The company is expanding its presence in Asia and emerging markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, manufacturing key metal chassis and components for computer and server hardware. It supplies these components to downstream server manufacturers and system integrators. It also controls upstream mold design and production processes.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing AI server chassis and cooling solutions, especially water cooling and immersion liquid cooling technologies. The company invests in automation and smart manufacturing to improve efficiency and product quality. R&D focuses on new server chassis designs (1U, 2U Intel Edge MHS, Nvidia MGX AI Server), energy-saving chassis, thermal management, and expanding product lines to meet AI, 5G, IoT, and cloud computing demands. Planned R&D expenditure for 2025 is approximately NT$75 million.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of computer and server chassis and related components. The company also earns from mold manufacturing and related services. There is no indication of subscription or licensing models; revenue depends on sales volume and product mix.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a leading supplier of high-value server chassis and cooling solutions, leveraging strong R&D, automated production, and quality management. It competes in a market with low-end chassis manufacturers facing price competition but differentiates through innovation and customer service. It maintains competitive advantages through comprehensive manufacturing capabilities, mold design expertise, and close partnerships with global IT firms.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$9.41 billion, a 45.6% increase from the previous year, and net profit of NT$730 million, with earnings per share rising 181%. Total assets reached NT$8.68 billion, with equity of NT$4.45 billion, reflecting a growth trajectory driven by AI server demand. The company maintains a strong financial structure with increasing retained earnings and capital surplus.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its advanced cooling technologies (water and immersion liquid cooling) tailored for AI servers, high automation and smart manufacturing for quality and efficiency, and strong R&D capabilities enabling rapid product innovation. It offers diversified chassis designs meeting evolving customer needs, backed by robust supply chain management and global production footprint. Its commitment to sustainability, ESG integration, and customer-centric service further differentiates it in the competitive server chassis market.
